title: Bee settings
description: User (~/.config/bee/settings.json) and workspace (.bee/settings.json) settings. Unknown keys are allowed so plugins can add their own.

editor.fontSize.description: Font size of the editor in pixels.

editor.tabSize.description: Number of spaces a tab is equal to.

workbench.colorTheme.description: Color theme of the workbench, editor and terminal.

files.exclude.description: Glob patterns (relative to the workspace) hidden from the explorer. Merged with the defaults; set a pattern to false to show it again.

files.associations.description: Glob pattern to language id, e.g. {"*.conf": "shellscript"}. Patterns containing a slash match the workspace-relative path, others the file name. Wins over what languages contribute.

plugins.disabled.description: Names of installed plugins not to load.

plugins.workspace.enabled.description: Load plugins from the workspace's .bee/plugins folder. Off by default: plugins run with your permissions, so only enable this for folders you trust. Only takes effect in user settings.

search.exclude.description: Glob patterns (relative to the workspace) left out of searches, on top of files.exclude. Set a pattern to false to search it again.

search.maxResults.description: A search stops after this many matches.

terminal.integrated.shell.description: Shell started by new terminals. Defaults to $SHELL when it is set.

terminal.integrated.fontSize.description: Font size of the terminal in pixels.
